bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden November 7, 2025

The Guild of Harwich Artists held our 8th annual ‘Make-it-Take-it’  community painting event on Saturday, September 13th, during the Harwich Cranberry Arts & Crafts Festival at the Harwich Community Center.  The popular free event attracted over 120 participants of all ages.  Guild artists set up painting stations in a variety of mediums allowing folks to try their hand at creating artworks that they get to take home with them.  For the first time face painting was introduced…one is never too young to learn the magic of art. The event is made possible by a grant from the Harwich Cultural Council.
